arxiv-2012-00174.title: What are the most important statistical ideas of the past 50 years? To appear in the Journal of the American Statistical Association . We thank Bin Yu, Brad Efron, Tom Belin, Trivellore Raghunathan, Chuanhai Liu, Sander Greenland, Howard Wainer, Anna Menacher, and anonymous reviewers for helpful com
arxiv-2012-00174.creator: Andrew Gelman, Aki Vehtari
arxiv-2012-00174.description: Abstract We review the most important statistical ideas of the past half century, which we categorize as: counterfactual causal inference, bootstrapping and simulation-based inference, overparameterized models and regularization, Bayesian multilevel models, generic computation algorithms, adaptive decision analysis, robust inference, and exploratory data analysis.

arxiv-2102-10946.title: Thermal properties of light mesons from holography
arxiv-2102-10946.creator: Xuanmin Cao, Songyu Qiu, Hui Liu, and Danning Li
arxiv-2102-10946.description: Abstract The thermal properties of light mesons, including the temperature dependence of their masses (both screening and pole masses) and thermal widths, are studied in a two-flavor ( N f = 2 N_{f}=2 ) soft-wall AdS/QCD model. By solving the spatial correlation functions, we extract the screening masses ( m scr m_{\rm{scr}} ) from their poles.

arxiv-2202-01914.title: Tsetlin Machine for Solving Contextual Bandit Problems
arxiv-2202-01914.creator: Raihan Seraj, Jivitesh Sharma, Ole-Christoffer Granmo
arxiv-2202-01914.description: Abstract This paper introduces an interpretable contextual bandit algorithm using Tsetlin Machines, which solves complex pattern recognition tasks using propositional logic. The proposed bandit learning algorithm relies on straightforward bit manipulation, thus simplifying computation and interpretation. We then present a mechanism for performing Thompson sampling with Tsetlin Machine, given its non-parametric nature.

arxiv-2210-11532.title: DNN-ForwardTesting: A New Trading Strategy Validation using Statistical Timeseries Analysis and Deep Neural Networks
arxiv-2210-11532.creator: Ivan Letteri, Giuseppe Della Penna, Giovanni De Gasperis, Abeer Dyoub
arxiv-2210-11532.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ivan Letteri, Giuseppe Della Penna, Giovanni De Gasperis, Abeer Dyoub. In general, traders test their trading strategies by applying them on the historical market data ( backtesting ), and then apply to the future trades the strategy that achieved the maximum profit on such past data.

arxiv-2406-03972.title: Eigenpath traversal by Poisson-distributed phase randomisation
arxiv-2406-03972.creator: Joseph Cunningham, Jérémie Roland
arxiv-2406-03972.description: Abstract We present a framework for quantum computation, similar to Adiabatic Quantum Computation (AQC), that is based on the quantum Zeno effect. By performing randomised dephasing operations at intervals determined by a Poisson process, we are able to track the eigenspace associated to a particular eigenvalue.

arxiv-2406-14002.title: A Collaborative Explanation of Cosmic Ray Spectrum Based on the Gluon Condensation Model
arxiv-2406-14002.creator: Jintao Wu, Jianhong Ruan
arxiv-2406-14002.description: Abstract Based on the Gluon Condensation (GC) model, the relationship between the spectra of electrons, γ \gamma rays, and neutrinos in cosmic rays can be deduced. It has been found that these particles share the same parameter, β p \beta_{p} , and have an identical GC threshold values.

arxiv-2411-05611.title: Superconducting Energy Gap Structure of CsV 3 Sb 5 from Magnetic Penetration Depth Measurements Journal: J. Phys.: Condens. Matter
arxiv-2411-05611.creator: Morgan J Grant, Yi Liu, Guang-Han Cao, Joseph A Wilcox, Yanfeng Guo, Xiaofeng Xu, Antony Carrington
arxiv-2411-05611.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Morgan J Grant, Yi Liu, Guang-Han Cao, Joseph A Wilcox, Yanfeng Guo, Xiaofeng Xu, Antony Carrington. Experimental determination of the structure of the superconducting order parameter in the kagome lattice compound CsV 3 Sb 5 is an essential step towards understanding the nature of the superconducting pairing in this material.

arxiv-2505-11344.title: Dynamic Base Model Shift for Delta Compression
arxiv-2505-11344.creator: Chenyu Huang, Peng Ye, Shenghe Zheng, Xiaohui Wang, Lei Bai, Tao Chen, Wanli Ouyang
arxiv-2505-11344.description: Abstract Transformer-based models with the pretrain-finetune paradigm bring about significant progress, along with the heavy storage and deployment costs of finetuned models on multiple tasks. Delta compression attempts to lower the costs by reducing the redundancy of delta parameters (i.e., the difference between the finetuned and pre-trained model weights) through pruning or quantization.

arxiv-2507-21868.title: Two-neutrino β ​ β \beta\beta decay to excited states at next-to-leading order Journal: Physics Letters B
arxiv-2507-21868.creator: Daniel Castillo, Dorian Frycz, Beatriz Benavente, Javier Menéndez
arxiv-2507-21868.description: Abstract We study two-neutrino double-beta decay ( 2 ​ ν ​ β ​ β 2\nu\beta\beta ) into first-excited 0 2 + 0^{+}_{2} states of nuclei used in β ​ β \beta\beta decay experiments, including 76 Ge, 82 Se, 130 Te, and 136 Xe.

arxiv-2511-15336.title: On the phase aberration estimation using common mid-angle correlations
arxiv-2511-15336.creator: Naiara Korta Martiartu, Michael Jaeger
arxiv-2511-15336.description: Abstract Phase aberrations, despite degrading ultrasound images, also encode valuable information about the spatial distribution of the speed of sound in tissue. In pulse-echo ultrasound, we can quantify them by exploiting speckle correlations. Among existing strategies, correlations between steered acquisitions that share a common mid-angle have proven particularly effective for inferring the speed of sound.

arxiv-2512-23060.title: Finding Quasars behind the Galactic Plane. IV. Candidate Selection from Chandra with Random Forest
arxiv-2512-23060.creator: Xu Zhang, Yanli Ai, Yanxia Zhang, Yuming Fu, Xue-Bing Wu, Zhiying Huo, Wenfeng Wen, Jiayuan Zhou, Dexuan Kong, Linfeng Zeng, Heng Wang
arxiv-2512-23060.description: Abstract Quasar samples remain severely incomplete at low Galactic latitudes because of strong extinction and source confusion. We conduct a systematic search for quasars behind the Galactic plane using X-ray sources from the Chandra Source Catalog (CSC 2.1), combined with optical data from Gaia DR3 and mid-infrared data from CatWISE2020.

pmc-11325758.creator: Fatma Kavak Akelma, Savaş Altınsoy, Burak Nalbant, Derya Özkan, Jülide Ergil
pmc-11325758.description: BackgroundWe aimed to evaluate the effects of preoperative listening to patient-preferred music and classical music on postoperative anxiety and recovery.MethodsA prospective, randomized controlled, single-blind study included 255 patients who were scheduled for elective inguinal hernia operation under general anesthesia. Spielberger state State-Trait Anxiety Inventory form 1,2 (STAI-I, STAI-II), Quality of Recovery Score-40 (QoR-40) were applied in the preoperatively.

pmc-11360641.title: Predictors for prescription of noninvasive ventilation in the postoperative period of cardiac surgery: a systematic review
pmc-11360641.creator: Jéssica Gonçalves de Lima, Victoria Maria Garcia de Medeiros, Fernando Gomes de Jesus, Thaísa Sarmento dos Santos, Juliana Rega de Oliveira, Claudia Rosa de Oliveira, Mauro Felippe Felix Mediano, Luiz Fernando Rodrigues Junior
pmc-11360641.description: IntroductionThe postoperative (PO) period after cardiac surgery is associated with the occurrence of respiratory complications. Noninvasive positive pressure ventilation (NIPPV) is largely used as a ventilatory support strategy after the interruption of invasive mechanical ventilation. However, the variables associated with NIPPV prescription are unclear.

pmc-11438267.title: Implementation of competency-based education for quality midwifery programmes in Africa: a scoping review
pmc-11438267.creator: Waleola Bukola Ige, Winnie Baphumelele Ngcobo, Opeyemi Afolabi
pmc-11438267.description: BackgroundImproving the quality of midwifery education to international standards is critical to prepare competent midwives. Despite the recognised impact of competent midwives, little is known concerning the implementation of Competency-Based Education (CBE), especially in Africa, where poor investment in quality midwifery education has been reported.

pmc-11522670.title: An Evaluation of the Design of Multimedia Patient Education Materials in Musculoskeletal Health Care: Systematic Review
pmc-11522670.creator: Garett Van Oirschot, Amanda Pomphrey, Caoimhe Dunne, Kate Murphy, Karina Blood, Cailbhe Doherty
pmc-11522670.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundEducational multimedia is a cost-effective and straightforward way to administer large-scale information interventions to patient populations in musculoskeletal health care. While an abundance of health research informs the content of these interventions, less guidance exists about optimizing their design.ObjectiveThis study aims to identify randomized controlled trials of patient populations with musculoskeletal conditions that used multimedia-based patient educational materials (PEMs) and examine how design was reported and impacted patients’ knowledge and rehabilitation outcomes.

pmc-11606192.title: IRF2 Affects LPS- and IFN-γ-Induced Pro-Inflammatory Responses, Cell Viability, Migration and Apoptosis of Macrophages by Regulating IRG1
pmc-11606192.creator: Ru-Xue Qin, Xue-Ying Ma, Zi-Yu Han, Shi-Ya Ma, Zhao-jian Shen, Zhong-Hua Lu, Yun Sun, Wei-Li Yu
pmc-11606192.description: BackgroundMembers of the interferon regulatory factor (IRF) family are transcriptional regulators that play vital roles in the inflammatory response of macrophages. IRF1, IRF3, and IRF9 regulate the expression of immune-responsive gene 1 (IRG1) in macrophages. However, the role of IRF2 in the inflammatory response of macrophages remains somewhat contradictory.

pmc-11644774.title: Application of Microwave-Assisted Water Extraction (MAWE) to Fully Realize Various Physiological Activities of Melaleuca quinquenervia Leaf Extract
pmc-11644774.creator: Ting-Kang Lin, Jyh-Yih Leu, Yi-Lin Lai, Yu-Chi Chang, Ying-Chien Chung, Hsia-Wei Liu
pmc-11644774.description: Melaleuca quinquenervia is widely grown in tropical areas worldwide. Studies have demonstrated that extracts of its buds, leaves, and branches obtained through hydrodistillation, steam distillation, or solvent extraction exhibit physiological activities, including anti-melanogenic, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties; nevertheless, such extracts are mostly not effectively collected or adequately utilized.

pmc-12389805.title: Exploring Difference in Hand–Foot Coordination Ability Among Tennis Players of Different Sport Levels Based on the Correlation Between Lower-Limb Acceleration and Hand Grip Force
pmc-12389805.creator: Yan Xiao, Jinghui Zhong, Yang Gao, Kebao Zhang, Christian Peham
pmc-12389805.description: Purpose: To quantify real-time hand–foot coupling in tennis and test whether the coupling pattern differs by playing standard. Methods: Fifteen nationally certified second-level male athletes and fifteen recreational beginners performed multi-directional swings, alternating forehand–backhand groundstrokes and serve-and-volley sequences while tri-axial ankle acceleration and racket-grip force were synchronously recorded in wearable inertial measurement units (IMUs).

pmc-13111357.title: EEG hyperscanning in intellectual disability: a scoping review with implications for cognitive stimulation therapy
pmc-13111357.creator: Pavithra Pavithra, James K. Bradshaw Bernacchi, Salma Ahmed, Garret McDermott, Mary McCarron, Philip McCallion, Eimear McGlinchey, Alejandro Lopez Valdes
pmc-13111357.description: Electroencephalography (EEG) hyperscanning has emerged as a valuable method for examining social dynamics during group-based activities and may serve as a promising outcome measure in group interventions. Cognitive stimulation therapy (CST) is one such interventions shown to improve cognition and quality of life in people with dementia and has recently been adapted for individuals with intellectual disability (ID).

pmc-13616678.title: Combined vitamins D3 and K2 as potential modulators of multiple myeloma cell pathophysiology: transcriptomic and epigenetic effects under standard culture and bone marrow-like conditions
pmc-13616678.creator: Karolina Łuczkowska, Patrycja Stodolak, Piotr Kulig, Bogusław Machaliński
pmc-13616678.description: IntroductionMultiple myeloma is an incurable hematological malignancy that requires extensive research to understand its biology and identify novel therapeutic strategies. Hypoxia within the tumor microenvironment affects numerous biological processes, including enhancing cellular stress resistance, promoting angiogenesis, shifting metabolism toward anaerobic glycolysis, and modulating gene expression and epigenetic modifications.
